name: Anthropic Sandbox Runtime (srt)
summary: Lightweight OS-level sandbox enforcing filesystem and network restrictions on agents, MCP servers and arbitrary processes, without a container.
description: Uses native OS primitives (`sandbox-exec` on macOS, `bubblewrap` with the network namespace removed on Linux, and on Windows a dedicated `srt-sandbox` user account with a Windows Filtering Platform egress fence) plus host-side HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies that enforce domain allow and deny lists. Defaults: network and writes are denied until allowed (`allowedDomains`, `allowWrite`), but reads are allowed everywhere unless you add `denyRead` paths. A beta research preview developed for Claude Code; install with `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime` and run `srt "<command>"`, or wrap local MCP servers in `.mcp.json`.
